1: The sequence $(a_n)$ is defined by the formula $a_{n+1}=a_n+n-6$ for every natural number $n\ge1$. The third term of this sequence equals $a_3=-1$. The term $a_2$ equals: A. $-3$  B. $-2$  C. $2$  D. $3$
2: The number of common points of the graphs of the functions $y=-x+1$ and $y=\log_2x$ equals: A. $0$  B. $1$  C. $2$  D. $3$
6: Determine the largest integer satisfying the inequality $|x|<|x-1025|$. In the boxes below enter, in order, the hundreds digit, the tens digit and the units digit of the result obtained.
7: The line with equation $y=\frac{3}{4}x-\frac{61}{14}$ is tangent to a circle with center $S=(1,-4)$. Determine the radius of this circle.
10: Solve the equation $4\sin^2x(1-\sin x)=\cos^2x(3-\sin x)$, for $x\in(-\pi,0]$.
11: A circle is inscribed in a right triangle with leg lengths 15 and 20. Compute the length of the segment joining the vertex of the right angle of this triangle with the point where the circle touches the hypotenuse.
13: Compute how many five-digit even natural numbers there are, in whose decimal representation the digit 2 occurs at most twice.
14: The base of the pyramid $ABCDS$ is a trapezoid $ABCD$. The diagonal $AC$ of this trapezoid has length $8\sqrt3$, is perpendicular to leg $BC$, and forms an angle of $30°$ with the longer base $AB$ of the trapezoid. Every lateral edge of this pyramid has the same length $4\sqrt5$. Compute the distance of the foot of the pyramid's height from its lateral edge $SD$.
15: The function $f$ is defined by the formula $f(x)=\frac{m^2+m-6}{m-5}x^2-(m-2)x+m-5$ for every real number $x$. Determine the integer values of the parameter $m$ for which the function $f$ attains a greatest value and has two distinct zeros of the same sign.
16: Consider all cones in which the sum of the slant height and the base radius equals 2. Determine the height of the cone among those considered whose volume is greatest. Compute that volume.
